items:
Pack your bags and get ready to relax—the Red Rooster at Seacrest Beach is ready to host your next escape! Whether you're here for a family getaway or a retreat with friends, this property provides the perfect backdrop for unforgettable memories.

* Private Beach — 0.4 miles to Seacrest Beach! Access via a short walk or community trolley.
* Resort Pool Oasis — 1200 sq ft pool with a pool side snack bar from the front door.
* Three King Beds — each with a king size bed and its own ensuite bath and balcony.
* Prime Location — Blocks from fine dining restaurants, bars and fun on 30a.

This home is the perfect backdrop for a family getaway or a reunion with friends.

Main Living Area
* Open-Concept Design: Beautiful hardwood floors throughout a bright, airy layout.
* Dining Area: Large dining table with grand center island crafted for maximum space for meal prep, casual dining.
* Gourmet Kitchen: Fully equipped with granite countertops and modern stainless-steel appliances.
* Grill Mates: In addition to the gas grill and Green Egg, all necessary grilling utensils are provided.
* Relaxing Living Room: Features a large sofa sleeper, perfect for movie nights or post-beach naps.
* Laundry Room: Full-size washer and dryer to keep beach towels clean and ready for use.
* Quiet Workspace: A dedicated desk area on the third floor for remote work or quick planning.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms
* 3 Rooms: Each with a king bed, boasting high-end linens, plenty of natural light, and its own private balcony retreat.
* Playful Bunk Room: The kids will love their dedicated sleeping area, perfect for recharging after a day at the resort pool.
* Luxurious Bath Spaces: From refreshing walk-in showers to a calming jetted tub, our bathrooms provide a spa-like experience at home.

Outdoor Space
* Parking: 4 parking spaces are allocated for this property. Boats, trailers, RVs, golf carts, LSVs, Mokes or ATVs are prohibited.
* 7 decks offer the best of both worlds: sun-drenched spaces for reading and peaceful, shaded retreats for a quick nap.
* Back patio with a new gas grill and green egg for evening cookouts.
* Enjoy the lush, manicured greenbelt right outside — ideal for playing bocce ball or cornhole with family and friends.

Unique Benefits
Seacrest Beach Community
A premier 30A destination where luxury meets coastal charm.

Explore 30A
You are perfectly positioned between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. A quick 15-minute walk connects you to world-class dining, high-end boutiques, and the vibrant local energy of the Village of South Walton.

Effortless Beach Access
Getting to the emerald waters is a breeze. Enjoy our complimentary tram service (March–October) that picks you up right at your door, or take a scenic stroll through the Sunset community boardwalk to our private deeded beach.

Beach Service
You can reserve beach chairs or setup a beach bonfire by visiting La Dolce Vita on-line reservation portal or give them a call.

Walking Trails
Over 1.35 miles of shaded walking trails winding through the community.

Guest Access
Enjoy the freedom of a private coastal escape! We provide a seamless self-check-in process so you can start your vacation on your own schedule. If you need anything at all, we’re just a message or phone call away.

Arrival Details:
Stop by Guest Services (open 9 AM – 8 PM) to pick up your Welcome Packet containing amenity wristbands, parking passes, a copy of the community rules, and a map of the neighborhood identifying all the tram stops. PLEASE note that wristbands are required for all guests over the age of 8 to access community amenities.

What’s Included:
* Bicycles: 4 adult size bikes are provided for guests, if more are needed head on over to the Peddlers Pavilion.
* Beach Essentials: We provide beach towels, chairs, and an umbrella.
* Starter Essentials: A starter kit to get you settled while you wait for your grocery delivery or pickup.
* Community Tram: Stop by a sign and give them a call; tram is on its way.
* Beautiful Grounds: Take a walk along the paths through delightful courtyards containing benches, bocci ball, corn hole games.

Please note: The primary guest must be at least 25 years of age.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
